newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jospin meets Chirac to present cabinet list.
newsitem.headline: Jospin meets Chirac to present cabinet list.

text.p: New French Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin met conservative President Jacques Chirac on Wednesday to present his cabinet list, which requires the head of state's approval.

Jospin arrived at the Elysee palace at 1330 GMT after completing talks with the Communist party, the ecologist Greens and the anti-Maastricht Citizens' Movement on joining a government dominated by his Socialist party.
